name: Desert roses
author: pestanzul on Public Domain Recipes
steps: Cut the butter in slices, put in in a bowl and leave it at room temperature until it's easy to knead.
Add 120 g powdered sugar and knead until uniform.
If the dough becomes sticky, keep in the fridge for 15-30 minutes before going on.
Add flour and knead until uniform.
Pour corn flakes in a plate.
Make dough balls about a tablespoon in size and roll them on corn flakes until they are covered.
Press until corn flakes don't fall when you raise the ball, then flatten slightly.
If you want, sprinkle powdered sugar on the biscuits.
Some people add chocolate, raisins or other ingredients in the dough.
They are nice additions but they don't belong the original recipe, which is intended to resemble crystal formations called desert roses.
